about_the_game:
Capture. Enhance. Dominate.

Choose an attack from your list (1 to 10), press Spin, and an attack zone rotates around your creature. If it hits an enemy, it takes damage - and if it's a new creature, you automatically capture it!

But beware: each Spin costs credits. Once the credits run out, the enemies get stronger and the stakes rise.

Manage your vampire cat army

Each captured creature can be upgraded (HP and damage up to level 10), but everything is paid for in dollars that you earn by eliminating enemies. The more you invest, the more upgrades cost.

A strategic system urges you to manage your resources carefully: your attacks can no longer be reused until you've reached a quota of dollars. Once this threshold has been reached, a choice of bonuses or maluses is imposed, making each game unique and increasingly difficult.

short_description: Vampire Cat is a 2D idle roguelike game where you capture, upgrade, and command vampire cats in looping tactical battles. Choose your attack, spin, defeat enemies, capture them, and build a supernatural army. Every decision counts.
supported_languages: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Bulgarian, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Korean, Danish, Spanish - Latin America, Finnish, Greek, Hungarian, Indonesian, Japanese, Norwegian, Dutch, Polish, Portuguese - Brazil, Portuguese - Portugal, Romanian, Russian, Swedish, Czech, Thai, Turkish, Ukrainian, Vietnamese
